title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Certificate Renewal Conditions
content:
**Renewal notice.** Under the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** a renewal notice is mailed to the borrower 45 calendar days (the tier's renewal notice period) before a certificate expires.

**Renewal.** The certificate renews on its expiration date for another 12 calendar months when no acceptable borrower evidence has been received by then and the loan is still serviced by the lender with the building in a Special Flood Hazard Area; the limit and premium are recomputed from the balances reported at renewal. **The clause "the limit and premium are recomputed from the balances reported at renewal" is no longer in force for a renewal on the Residential Mandatory Amount tier, whose renewed building limit and premium for the renewed term are figured under the residential renewal schedule from the mandatory purchase amount that schedule sets for the renewed term; at the renewal of every other certificate the limit and premium are still recomputed from the balances reported at renewal.** A certificate whose program is terminated does not renew.

| On the expiration date… | Renews? |
|---|---|
| No acceptable borrower evidence received, loan still serviced by the lender, building in a Special Flood Hazard Area, program not terminated | Yes, for another 12 months |
| Acceptable borrower evidence received by then | No |
| Program terminated | No |

The renewal entry records the renewed term; the renewal premium is billed on the statement for the month the certificate is renewed.

superseded_clauses: the limit and premium are recomputed from the balances reported at renewal
